one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.20586）：Continuum Attention 把因果 Transformer attention 的'discrete key/value lookup / 离散 token 边界'拉到'continuum attention：连续分段线性 memory curve + query 沿曲线诱导 exponential relevance density + closed-form moment 解 + analytic gradient'。是 inference-serving × context-engineering 的 'continuous-curve attention operator' 趋势资产——'closed-form continuous attention' 范式可迁移到任何 'long-context attention / memory-curve attention / closed-form attention / continuous attention operator' 子方向（long-context agent、long doc RAG、agentic memory），与 aiutil 长期关注的 inference-serving × context-engineering 主线在 'continuous-curve attention' 层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无（仅 PDF / arXiv），需打开 PDF 看连续 memory curve 形式化（piecewise linear 参数化）、closed-form moment 是否在长上下文下稳定、跨 task 验证、与 sparse / sliding-window / linear attention baseline 对照。今日新趋势卡片：维持 7-30 天滚动观察周期。
